title: Dynamic substitutions as dynamic meta algorithm with plugin system

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

body: see vision discussion: We need to make sure we support wide range of task, by using data discovery, conversion of discovered online instructions into turing complete event driven storable substitutions as in link-cli readme, and make sure we have static, compiled part of Formal AI and interactice dynamic part, and if we use sufficiently and frequently dynamic parts of meta algorithm we can suggest user to improve execution (thinking) speed by recompiling the static meta algorithm part with included dynamic meta algorithm parts that are used too frequently, and vice versa, something that is not used too frequently often in specific instance of Formal AI can be uncompiled, yet kept as dynamic part of it. As part of this issue we do it only with user confirmation or controlled on server. If user is not server admin he may not have permissions to configure that, when Formal AI served to general public. Yet admin still can have access to give text command to apply changes to static part of meta algorithm. Dynamic part can be used to convert algorithms found in the internet to small recipes/functions/scripts which can be triggered by Formal AI or user by demand so Formal AI can think/reason about algorithms, compare than, and execute step by step with all debugging info needed, so Formal AI should be capable of deeply understanding any algorithm before applying it to any software as part or the whole as per user’s requirements. We should should support event driving architecture and associative packages similar to what we had in https://github.com/deep-foundation, yet adapted for doublets link store and Type -> Type, Type -> SubType, SubType -> Value, where all Type, SubType and Values are just types system. So any npm/rust package or just GitHub repository can be dynamic package, which may contain some dataset, skill (logic), useful functions, integrations with other systems and so on. So effectlively each such package is plugin in the system. We also need to make sure our system is event driven and substitution driven by default, so each create/update/delete of links may trigger some other actions, which can do cascade, and also have ability to do self modification in real time (yet by default it should be turned off for safety, yet user should be able to turn it on in settings/contiguration or using natural language). So we can have algorithms which are trully dynamic and can be easily be parallelizable, as each when x do y or substitute x to y may operate independently on each cycle between transactions, if link-cli does not implement it nicely we do workaround and report issue there. We also need to have some basic example of translation between meta language, common programming languages and natural languages, so all such rules can be translated to algorithms, and algorithms can be translated to rules, using all the same substitution rules. So we do few basic examples to establish architecture for translation, later we will make it more advanced. If architecture changes are needed to make our system more advanced do these changes, our architecture is still flexible and we are searching for best structure for it. Also make sure we have overall architecture description, and all docs are in sync with the codebase. We should also use our Formal AI system for coding as much as possible (as sub agent) using our JavaScript version for fast iteration, we try - it fails - we fix and so on, see our guidelines. We should use it for wrong statements detection in documentation in relation to codebase and facts in the internet, and also for making coding changes themselves so we ensure our Formal AI system capable helping code itself sooner. We must update our vision, and also open issues pull requests about dreaming should get comments about that we can include also this part once this issue's pull request merged as part of automatic dreaming process. So our system works with dynamic equilibrium or dynamic self balancing. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
